name: cloud-architecture-design
description: Cloud architecture design for AWS / Azure / GCP (or multi-cloud). Selects compute paradigm (containers / VMs / serverless / managed services), regions + availability zones, storage tiers, networking topology (VPC / subnets / peering), identity (IAM), managed services fit-for-purpose. Cost-optimization, reserved capacity, and landing-zone foundation. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
